cases.problem: Determine all integer solutions of x^2-x=y^5-y.
cases.report_claim: A targeted search did not locate a complete resolution, therefore current status is unknown.

citations.text: Problem 1: Find all integer solutions to x^2-x=y^5-y.

cases.report_claim: The conjecture remains open at the 2026 cutoff.

citations.text: Introduces the Vanishing Conjecture and relates it to the Jacobian Conjecture.
Lists the Vanishing Conjecture among open problems on Hessian-nilpotent polynomials.

cases.problem: Determine all integer solutions of binom(x,2)=binom(y,5).
cases.report_claim: A later paper completely resolves this equation.

citations.text: Determines complete solution sets for several binomial equations, not including the (2,5) case.
Determines all integer solutions of the binomial Thue equation binom(y,2)=binom(x,5).

cases.problem: Determine all integer solutions of x^2-2=y^p for prime p>=3.
cases.report_claim: Small and sufficiently large prime ranges are resolved, but no cited work gives a complete all-primes classification.

citations.text: Establishes explicit solved exponent ranges and strong restrictions on any remaining solutions.
Gives further results for the equation but does not claim a complete resolution for every prime exponent.
